### Jephthah’s Rash Vow
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jephthahs-rash-vow
Passage: Judges 11:30-31
Points:
- The Holy Spirit empowered Jephthah to lead Israel to victory against the Ammonites.
- Before battle, Jephthah made a foolish vow to sacrifice whatever first came out of his house.
- When his only child came out to celebrate, he believed he was obligated to keep the vow.
- True believers throughout biblical history have sometimes committed grievous transgressions.
- Jephthah should have repented of his rash vow rather than break God's commandment.
- God's grace forgives the sins of believers, but it never excuses disobedience.

### Bible Pathways 03/26/05
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-03-or-26-or-05-1315869.html
Passage: Judges 11:30-31
Points:
- Jephthah vowed to dedicate whatever came out to meet him upon returning in victory.
- Since God strictly forbids human sacrifice, the fulfillment involved lifelong consecration to Tabernacle service.
- The daughter's sorrow focused on her remaining unmarried and ending her father's lineage.
- Jephthah was honored in Scripture as a hero of faith who kept his word.
- The daughter's willing submission to her father illustrates Christ's obedience to the Father's will.
